# FIP-003 Domain Foundation

Use the lifecycle in `.github/prompts/phase1-frontend-implementation.prompt.md`.

## Authorization

Invocation of this prompt authorizes **FIP-003 only**. Do not implement FIP-004 or later. Do not commit or push.

## Primary Source

`docs/fip-003-domain-foundation-plan.md`

Read this Primary Source before editing. It is the implementation authority for FIP-003.

## Context Rule

Do **not** preload requirements, MVP, architecture, API, security, test, decisions, Phase 0 review, Cross-Phase review, or later FIP documents. If the Primary Source leaves one concrete implementation question unresolved, read only the exact supporting document/section it cites for that question. Stop if ambiguity remains implementation-affecting.

## Scope and Files

Derive the exact domain models, validation rules, expected/allowed files, prohibited work, dependencies, and Acceptance Criteria directly from the Primary Source. This prompt intentionally does not duplicate those formal rules, so `docs/fip-003-domain-foundation-plan.md` remains the single Source of Truth.

## Required Validation

Run the exact validation commands defined by the FIP-003 Primary Source from `frontend/`:

```bash
dart format lib test
flutter analyze
flutter test test/conversation/domain
flutter test
```

During implementation/fix loops, prefer the focused domain test command before rerunning the full suite.

## Gate

FIP-003 is `PASS` only when the implementation is complete, all four required commands pass, the Primary Source Acceptance Criteria self-review passes, and no Stop Condition remains. Otherwise report `BLOCKED` with the concrete blocker and exact Source-of-Truth location. Then stop.
